'''Pevthak-Fra''' was a [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Posted at the [[Koss Overlook]] in the [[Gormak Lands]], he asked an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to kill or capture [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] leader [[Jokull]].

==Behind the scenes==
Pevthak-Fra is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
